lines: בִּטְחוֹנִי אַתָּה עִמִּי אַתָּה עִמִּי אַתָּה עִמִּי

review: Single 7-line stanza; shape 7 is the Arabic's own long line, not padded. Parentheses around the triple refrain in 1:5 stripped per house style; the threefold אַתָּה עִמִּי kept. ربي → רִבּוֹנִי, يسوع → יֵשׁוּעַ per glossary. No chorus.
